definitions.explanation: The quality of being sweet in taste. Used especially in food and cooking contexts when discussing the sweet element of a flavor profile.
A sweet food item, especially traditional Japanese sweets and desserts. Used as a general term for sweets in food culture contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦トマト→トマト：05192_tomato⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{甘味|かんみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: This tomato has a strong sweetness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{甘味|かんみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{立|た}つ→引き立つ：25243_hikitatsu⟧。
examples.english: Adding a little salt brings out the sweetness.

examples.japanese: {甘味|かんみ}{料|りょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}わ→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧な{甘味|かんみ}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げた→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧⟦ジャム→ジャム：01779_jamu⟧です。
examples.english: This is a jam finished using only the natural sweetness of the fruit, without any sweeteners.

examples.english: Would you like a dessert after your meal?

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{甘味|かんみ}{処|どころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{抹茶|まっちゃ}→抹茶：10574_maccha⟧⟦パフェ→パフェ：11122_pafe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。

examples.japanese: ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{老舗|しにせ}→老舗：16152_shinise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{甘味|かんみ}{処|どころ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スポット→スポット：11578_supotto⟧になっている。
examples.english: Kyoto has many long-established sweets shops, which have become popular spots for tourists.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
The same kanji {甘味|あまみ} can also be read あまみ, which means sweetness as a taste quality. The reading かんみ covers both the taste quality (sense 1) and the food item (sense 2), while あまみ is limited to the taste quality only.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {甘味|かんみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ (strong sweetness)
- {甘味|かんみ}{料|りょう} (sweetener)
- {甘味|かんみ}{処|どころ} (Japanese sweets shop)
- {甘味|かんみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧ (enjoy sweets)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {甘|あま}さ: sweetness (general, can be abstract — sweetness of life, etc.)
- ⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧: snacks, sweets (broader category including Western and Japanese sweets)
- ⟦{和菓子|わがし}→和菓子：04962_wagashi⟧: Japanese sweets (specifically traditional Japanese confections)
